question.text: In a building there are <math><mn>15</mn></math> bulbs of <math><mn>45</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> , <math><mn>15</mn></math> bulbs of <math><mn>100</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>15</mn></math> small fans of <math><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> and <math><mn>2</mn></math> heaters of <math><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> . The voltage of electric main supply is <math><mn>220</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> . The minimum fuse capacity (rated value) of the building will be:

solution.text:
Total power is 15×45+15×100+15×10+2×1000
=4325W
So current =4325220=19.66 A≈ 20 A

so we have to use a fuse which can tolerate atleast 20 A current.
